# Data Packet Management

Data packets (the Transactions grid): Elasticsearch search (`dataPackets`, filter by `Id`, `ServiceIds`, `Status`, `SearchString`), children by parent, counts over time / by status, daily error groups and report; PUT status / data (writes). No GET by id.

11 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

<a id="op-datapacket-getdailyerrorreport"></a>
### GET `/dailyErrorReport`

operationId `DataPacket_GetDailyErrorReport` · Retrieves errors grouped per dataflow across the tenant for a date range

Mirrors the content of the scheduled Daily Error Report email: by default only dataflows
with notifications enabled are included.

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FromDate` | query | string (date-time) |  | Start of the window (UTC). Defaults to 24 hours before ToDate. |
| `ToDate` | query | string (date-time) |  | End of the window (UTC). Defaults to now. |
| `OnlyNotificationEnabled` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Restrict to dataflows with notifications enabled. On by default because that is exactly the set the scheduled job mails; turning it off shows every dataflow that errored. |
| `IncludeHidden` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Include dataflows that have been hidden from the listings. |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfListOfGetDailyErrorReportResponse](#schema-resultoflistofgetdailyerrorreportresponse) | Daily error report retrieved successfully |
| `400` | [ResultOfListOfGetDailyErrorReportResponse](#schema-resultoflistofgetdailyerrorreportresponse) | Invalid window, for example a start date later than the end date |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have NavMenu.ReportsPage permission |
| `500` | [ResultOfListOfGetDailyErrorReportResponse](#schema-resultoflistofgetdailyerrorreportresponse) | Internal server error |

<a id="op-datapacket-senddailyerrorreport"></a>
### POST `/dailyErrorReport/send`

operationId `DataPacket_SendDailyErrorReport` · Emails the daily error report for a window to the signed-in user

The recipient is resolved from the authenticated principal, not from the request, so this
endpoint can only mail the caller. Rebuilds the report from the same query the page uses.

Parameters: _none_

Request body `command` (application/json), **required**: [SendDailyErrorReportCommand](#schema-senddailyerrorreportcommand)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Report sent |
| `400` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Invalid window, or the report could not be delivered |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have NavMenu.ReportsPage permission |
| `500` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Internal server error |

<a id="schema-messagestatus"></a>
### MessageStatus

Represents the various states a message can be in during its lifecycle in the message processing system.

Enum (integer). Send the **value**.

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| `0` | Default |
| `1` | InQueue |
| `2` | Success |
| `3` | Error |
| `4` | Resync |
| `5` | ReQueued |
| `6` | Refetch |
| `7` | Archive |

<a id="schema-senddailyerrorreportcommand"></a>
### SendDailyErrorReportCommand

Emails the tenant-wide Daily Error Report for a window to the requesting user.

Required: `onlyNotificationEnabled`, `includeHidden`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fromDate` | string (date-time) |  | Start of the window (UTC). Defaults to 24 hours before ToDate. |
| `toDate` | string (date-time) |  | End of the window (UTC). Defaults to now. |
| `onlyNotificationEnabled` | boolean | yes | Restrict to dataflows with notifications enabled. Defaults to true so an on-demand send matches the scheduled Daily Error Report email. |
| `includeHidden` | boolean | yes | Include dataflows hidden from the listings. |
